question: How do I register to vote in Carroll County?
answerText:
To register to vote in Ossipee, you must meet specific qualifications. You need to be at least 18 years old by election day, a United States citizen, and domiciled in Ossipee. You must also not be otherwise disqualified from voting [S1].

You can register on Election Day at the polls in Ossipee. When you register, you will need to provide a photo ID and proof of residence [L1, L2, L3]. Polls are typically open from 8 AM to 7 PM on Election Day [L1]. The Ossipee Town Clerk, Kellie J. Skehan, oversees voter registration duties [L2, L3]. The Supervisors of the Checklist also maintain voter lists and hold public sessions for registration [L4, S1]. A statewide voter registration application form is used for all registrations [S1].
